borrower_ledger.note: per chain and pledged token, from the Morpho replays: units pledged at that chain's snapshot block, the units behind positions abandoned by the end of the window, how much of those units was already pledged at the snapshot, and the borrowers' forfeited over-collateralization (collateral at the oracle's par value, less the recovery and less the depositors' principal shortfall on the same positions, floored at zero per position). The two variants credit the recovery to principal alone (par_minus_principal) and restrict the equity to the units pledged at the snapshot (snapshot_units).

excluded_totals.note: markets of the surface whose family token matched by symbol only; not part of this case (hit rules R9)

legacy_reconciliation.note: controlled redemption-price event, ~9 percent depeg vs USD; the census threshold revision R1 case

loan_side_basis.valued_at: recovery price at the valuation block

window.snapshot_rule: hit rules section 5: t0 - 24h, per chain
